name: StartupKit (Kit)
summary: StartupKit (startupkit.app), branded Kit, is a per-seat SaaS running hiring, security/VDP, training, performance reviews, outreach and compensation research for teams where none is a full-time job. Its Hiring module reaches AI assistants two ways: an in-app agent and a remote MCP server at /api/v1/mcp (OAuth). Write tools always act as the connected user: hiring_create_job_posting takes a title and an already-written Markdown body, creates a draft posting and returns its edit URL, and a human presses Publish. A separate no-auth docs/catalog MCP at /mcp is read-only. $8/seat/month.

agentAccess.notes: The hiring tools are a remote MCP at https://startupkit.app/api/v1/mcp reached over OAuth; creating a posting needs a Kit account, Hiring admin, the hiring_write scope and an active subscription. A separate docs/catalog MCP at /mcp answers initialize with no auth and exposes only read-only tools.

payments.notes: A human buys a per-seat subscription (get_plans, read first-hand from the public /mcp on 2026-11-23: 800 USD-cents/seat/month or 8000/year, 30-day trial, also in EUR/GBP/PLN). No agent-settled path; the agent surface is the subscriber's MCP connection, not a machine-payable endpoint.
